## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2021-09-14: S-1/A Amendment No. 1 files the form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.5.
- 2021-09-22: Up-C IPO closes; executed Tax Receivable Agreement dated September 22, 2021 between Brilliant Earth Group, Inc., Brilliant Earth, LLC, and the Members.
- 2021-09-27: 8-K reports the IPO and files the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.2.

#### Administrative amendment

- 2025-03-12: Amendment No. 1 to TRA executed; replaces LIBOR with a Replacement Rate mechanism. 85% payment percentage and beneficiary set unchanged. Filed as Exhibit 10.17 to the FY2024 10-K.

#### Economic write-down

- 2025-10-28: Delaware-to-Nevada reincorporation via Plan of Conversion; statutory conversion, no Change of Control, TRA continues without assignment.
- 2025-12-31: FY2025 10-K reports a $7.8M Q4 2025 "Gain on TRA liability adjustment" zeroing the recorded TRA payable concurrent with a full valuation allowance on deferred tax assets; the contract remains live but the recognized liability is $0.

## Explanation

The TRA originates from Brilliant Earth's September 22, 2021 Up-C IPO and obligates Brilliant Earth Group, Inc. to pay 85% of the Cumulative Net Realized Tax Benefit to the Mainsail Related Parties and Just Rocks Related Parties on Section 754 basis step-ups from redemptions of LLC Interests, plus imputed-interest deductions. A March 2025 Amendment No. 1 administratively replaced LIBOR with a Replacement Rate mechanism. At fiscal year-end 2025, the Company recognized a $7.8M gain reducing the TRA payable to zero alongside a full valuation allowance on the deferred tax assets, on the determination that realization of the underlying benefits was no longer more likely than not; the contract is not terminated and could be reinstated if future realization becomes probable. The October 2025 Delaware-to-Nevada reincorporation was a statutory conversion that did not trigger a Change of Control. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record and the same-contract analysis.
